title: Readiness command page tables (TAC-4135)
description: Pure HTML-string renderers (renderQuestionsTable, renderBlockingTable, buildQuestionRows, buildBlockingRows, entityDomId). The questions table has one row per question with number, group as a sortable column, ask, chain location, settles, state, and a Copy for your agent control (AC-18003-1, -2, -5, -8). The blocking table carries every failing item across every failing check across every stage, uncapped, with a FilterBar by stage and persona and composite id splitting via splitCompositeId (AC-18003-3).
